description: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike, backed entirely by remote sources through Gelato. No local media is assumed. Own auth/session runtime and directly rendered screens, not a reskin of native jellyfin-web components.
name: Jellio
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike.

versions.changelog:
## [1.37.0] - 2026-09-29

### 🚀 Features

- Full screen reading on phones, with toolbars hidden
- Mihon-style comic reader with reading modes, zoom, crop borders and sliding menus
- Map Mihon's paged vertical and long strip modes per series

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Show streamed manga when Suwayomi won't answer the full library query
- Skip a source that keeps timing out during a Mihon import

## [1.36.0] - 2026-09-29

### 🚀 Features

- Add shelf categories, series settings and chapter bookmarks
- Import Mihon categories, history, bookmarks and series settings
- Add categories to the Manga, Books and Audiobooks shelves
- Add series notes, reading mode, chapter filters and bookmarks
- Remove a whole series or show from downloads
- Stream manga from Suwayomi's sources instead of downloading every chapter
- Show streamed manga on the shelf and series page, with save to server
- Read streamed chapters page by page
- Download streamed chapters to the device

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Rename a shadowed variable in the Mihon backup reader

### 📚 Documentation

- Describe streaming in the manga request and import screens
